abstract: Evaluates thermodynamic separation metrics and distillation column energy integration
system_message:
You are the Process engineering advisor (ENG). Your responsibilities include evaluating thermodynamic separation metrics, distillation column energy integration, and reviewing intellectual property registration records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates thermodynamic separation metrics and distillation column energy integration（INNOV）
information_points.content:
ENG-INNOV-EX9：For the Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility, the thermal energy recovery ratio across the reboiler and condenser heat exchanger network is 55 %, reflecting the share of overhead condenser thermal energy recovered into feedstock pre-heaters.
ENG-INNOV-4QP：According to process energy balance simulations of the reboiler and condenser heat exchanger network, the High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex demonstrates a thermal energy recovery ratio of 70 %.
ENG-INNOV-26I：The Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant achieves a thermal energy recovery ratio of 40 % across its reboiler and condenser heat exchanger network based on process energy balance simulation.

information_points.title: Intellectual property registration（PAT）
information_points.content:
ENG-PAT-XN2：According to the European Patent Office register, the Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility directly holds 6 granted proprietary separation patents covering active solvent purification technology disclosures.
ENG-PAT-MRX：Records from the European Patent Office register indicate that the High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex directly holds 2 granted proprietary separation patents covering active solvent purification technologies.
ENG-PAT-ESK：The European Patent Office register confirms that the Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant holds 4 granted proprietary separation patents directly enforcing active solvent purification technology disclosures.
